introduced_by.description: Commit reviews only: the short SHA of the commit that introduced the issue, as the prompt's commit list shows it (the merge for code a merge brought in), or null. A claim the plugin checks against the range and git blame (plans/review-commits.md §2.6).

scope_relation.description: Optional: the reviewer's provisional scope classification of the issue's proposed action, "in_scope" | "scope_extension" | "unclear" (plans/scope-policy-and-report-tags.md §3). Deliberately untyped: a missing or malformed value reads "unclear" (utils/scope_policy.normalize_scope_fields) and never discards the issue.

scope_reason.description: Optional: one short line saying why, against the scope baseline.

scope_reference.description: Optional: the baseline section or text the classification rests on, or "".
